# 微信小游戏上线前工程快检

Independent pre-submission engineering review for one WeChat Mini Game project and one explicit version.

- Introductory price: CNY 99 for the first three projects.
- Delivery: within 24 hours after complete sanitized materials are received.
- Deliverable: Markdown or PDF risk report with summary, P0/P1/P2 findings, evidence locations, remediation advice, and one written Q&A round.
- Preferred projects: native JavaScript / Canvas. Cocos, Unity, and server-heavy scopes require confirmation first.
- Not included: code remediation, physical-device testing, filing, qualification applications, account operations, or formal submission.
- No guarantee of WeChat approval, publication time, traffic, or revenue.
- Never send passwords, AppSecret, API keys, tokens, cookies, verification codes, identity documents, or real user data.
- Fictional sample: https://github.com/yiten885-ux/wechat-minigame-preflight-service/blob/main/sample-report.md
- Scope inquiry: https://github.com/yiten885-ux/wechat-minigame-preflight-service/issues/new?template=service-inquiry.yml
